registration.title: Register Command EVE
registration.subtitle: One-time setup. Your details stay on this Mac — nothing is sent anywhere.
registration.consentLabel: I agree that my name, company and email are stored locally on this Mac only. No data is transmitted to FYN-Labs or any server.
registration.consentHint: Required. Command EVE keeps this record in the app's local data directory and never syncs it.

errors.fieldsRequired: Name, company and email are all required.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.consentRequired: Please confirm local storage to continue.
errors.unknown: Registration could not be saved. Please try again.

license.title: Enter your license code
license.subtitle: Paste the CEVE.v1 code the Command EVE team sent you. Verification runs fully offline on this Mac.

errors.LICENSE_MALFORMED: This code is not a valid Command EVE license. Check that you pasted it completely.
errors.LICENSE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This license was issued for a different Command EVE version. Ask the team for a current code.
errors.LICENSE_SIGNATURE_INVALID: This code's signature is invalid. It was not issued by Command EVE, or it was altered.
errors.LICENSE_EXPIRED: This license has expired. Ask the Command EVE team for a renewed code.
errors.LICENSE_NOT_YET_VALID: This license is not valid yet. Check the start date with the Command EVE team.
errors.LICENSE_KEY_UNCONFIGURED: License verification is not configured in this build. Contact the Command EVE team.
errors.REGISTRATION_REQUIRED: Please complete registration before entering a license code.
errors.unknown: The license code could not be verified. Please try again.

curtain.title: Your trial has ended
curtain.lede: Welcome back. Your 14-day Command EVE trial has ended. You can pick up right where you left off.
curtain.preservedBody: Your Company OS, memory, connections and SOPs are still saved and waiting for you. Nothing is deleted or reset.
curtain.hint: This opens the secure checkout page in your browser. Once your subscription is active, unlock Command EVE again with your new license code.

unconfigured.title: Activation unavailable
unconfigured.description: This build cannot verify license codes because no verification key is configured. Contact the Command EVE team, or start the app with the pilot fallback flag.
unconfigured.fallbackHint: Pilot fallback: set COMMAND_EVE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED=0 to bypass the gate.

error.title: Activation check failed
error.description: The activation status could not be read. Please restart Command EVE.
